goal: Resolve Dark Xoah survival and Vol 4 secret weapon arc
body: New design-active Shadow Dweller architecture: Route 2 Xoah is Dark Shadow Dweller, the hidden branch that hunts Prime across each Vol 2 leg and causally forges Prime Xoah² through pressure. X² eventually becomes strong enough to force convergence, but the stronger option is restraint: she realizes Dark Xoah is causally necessary and may still be needed. Keep both Xoahs autonomous into Vol 4. Existing locked endpoint remains: Xoah-Lin Oda ultimately defeats Shadow King/Nobunaga echo in Substrata, so Dark Xoah can be the secret weapon/second blade without replacing the victor. Explore payoff where Dark Xoah dies or voluntarily yields/converges only after her causal function completes, preserving agency. Need war-game: why Shadow King cannot fully counter Route 2 anomaly, two-Xoah combat choreography, whether Dark Xoah dies before/at/after final blow, what X² inherits, and how this feeds Kenji Vol 5 and Stage 10 without power creep. Do not lock exact death timing until Dave does.
